props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================


// Great Axe / Thievery Melee Animation


// Generic melee slide-in attack + target slash VFX + delayed hit blink feedback


//


// VFX:


// modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Melee/Group01/TrailAttack01_01_04_Regular_OrangeRed_800x600.webm


//


// SFX:


// https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage3.ogg


//


// Rule:


// - Pseudo Animation owns VFX + token blink feedback.


// - Sequencer is used only for SFX.


// ============================================================================


return (async () => {


const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][GreatAxe-Thievery]";


const VFX_FILE = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Melee/Group01/TrailAttack01_01_04_Regular_OrangeRed_800x600.webm";


const SFX_FILE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage2.ogg";


// ---------------- Timing knobs ----------------


const MOVE_IN_MS = 320;


const HIT_DELAY_MS = MOVE_IN_MS + 40;


const VFX_MS = 700;


const RETURN_MS = 280;


const END_BUFFER_MS = 140;


// Delay before the target blink feedback starts.


// Good range: 80–180ms.


// Increase this if the blink still feels too early.


const DAMAGE_FEEDBACK_DELAY_MS = 130;


// ---------------- Visual tuning knobs ----------------


const FRONT_OFFSET_PX = 115; // how far in front of target the caster stops


const CASTER_Z = 6200;


const VFX_Z = 6300;


const VFX_SCALE = 2.85;


const BLINK_TIMES = 3;


const BLINK_LOW_ALPHA = 0.25;


const BLINK_STEP_MS = 55;


// ---------------- Small helpers ----------------


const wait = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));


globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};


if (typeof ONI.emit !== "function") {


ONI.emit = function(eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {


const { local = true, world = false } = options;


if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);


if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });


};


}


async function resolveTokenFromUuid(uuid) {


if (!uuid || typeof uuid !== "string") return null;


try {


const doc = await fromUuid(uuid);


if (doc?.documentName === "Token") {


return doc.object ?? null;


}


if (doc?.documentName === "Actor") {


return doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;


}


if (doc?.actor?.getActiveTokens) {


return doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;


}


return doc?.object ?? null;


} catch (err) {


console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve UUID:", uuid, err);


return null;


}


}


async function resolveCasterToken(p) {


const candidates = [


p?.sourceTokenUuid,


p?.casterTokenUuid,


p?.tokenUuid,


p?.tokenUUID,


p?.meta?.sourceTokenUuid,


p?.meta?.casterTokenUuid,


p?.meta?.attackerTokenUuid,


p?.meta?.attackerUuid,


p?.attackerUuid,


p?.attackerActorUuid


].filter(Boolean);


for (const uuid of candidates) {


const token = await resolveTokenFromUuid(uuid);


if (token) return token;


}


return null;


}


async function resolveTargetTokens(p, rawTargets) {


const out = [];


const pushToken = async (value) => {


if (!value) return;


if (value?.document?.documentName === "Token") {


out.push(value);


return;


}


if (value?.documentName === "Token") {


if (value.object) out.push(value.object);


return;


}


if (typeof value === "string") {


const token = await resolveTokenFromUuid(value);


if (token) out.push(token);


}


};


const fromArg = Array.isArray(rawTargets) ? rawTargets : [];


for (const t of fromArg) await pushToken(t);


const uuidLists = [


p?.targetTokenUuids,


p?.targetTokenUUIDs,


p?.originalTargetUUIDs,


p?.targets,


p?.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs,


p?.meta?.targets


];


for (const list of uuidLists) {


if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue;


for (const uuid of list) await pushToken(uuid);


}


const seen = new Set();


return out.filter(t => {


const id = t?.document?.uuid ?? t?.id;


if (!id || seen.has(id)) return false;


seen.add(id);


return true;


});


}


const p = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


const casterToken = await resolveCasterToken(p);


const targetTokens = await resolveTargetTokens(p, targets ?? globalThis.__TARGETS ?? []);


if (!casterToken) {


console.warn(TAG, "No caster token resolved from payload. Animation cancelled.");


return false;


}


if (!targetTokens.length) {


console.warn(TAG, "No target tokens resolved from payload. Animation cancelled.");


return false;


}


const eventBase = {


type: "greatAxeThieveryMelee",


sourceTokenId: casterToken.id,


sourceTokenUuid: casterToken.document?.uuid ?? null,


targetTokenIds: targetTokens.map(t => t.id),


targetTokenUuids: targetTokens.map(t => t.document?.uuid).filter(Boolean),


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


};


try {


ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", eventBase, { local: true, world: false });


// ---------------- SFX: Sequencer only ----------------


if (typeof Sequencer !== "undefined") {


new Sequence()


.sound()


.file(SFX_FILE)


.volume(0.85)


.delay(HIT_DELAY_MS)


.play();


} else {


console.warn(TAG, "Sequencer not found. SFX skipped.");


}


// ---------------- VFX + movement: Pseudo Animation ----------------


if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {


console.warn(TAG, "game.ONI.pseudo.play not found. VFX skipped.");


await wait(HIT_DELAY_MS + VFX_MS + RETURN_MS + END_BUFFER_MS);


return true;


}


const scriptSource = `


const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;


if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Pseudo animation needs casterToken.");


const waitMs = wait;


function easeInOutCubic(t) {


return t < 0.5


? 4 * t * t * t


: 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;


}


function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / Math.max(1, durMs);


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = easeInOutCubic(t);


obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;


obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function makeTokenClone(token, zIndex) {


const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;


const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = token.center.x;


sprite.y = token.center.y;


if (baseObj) {


sprite.width = baseObj.width;


sprite.height = baseObj.height;


} else {


sprite.width = token.w;


sprite.height = token.h;


}


sprite.zIndex = zIndex;


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


return sprite;


}


async function makeVideoSprite(file) {


let texture = null;


try {


texture = await loadTexture(file);


} catch (_) {


texture = PIXI.Texture.from(file);


}


const video =


texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source ??


texture?.source?.resource?.source ??


null;


if (video && typeof video.play === "function") {


try {


video.loop = false;


video.muted = true;


video.currentTime = 0;


await video.play();


} catch (_) {}


}


return new PIXI.Sprite(texture);


}


async function playSlashVfx(targetToken) {


if (!targetToken) return;


const sprite = await makeVideoSprite(params.vfxFile);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = targetToken.center.x;


sprite.y = targetToken.center.y;


const size = Math.max(targetToken.w ?? 100, targetToken.h ?? 100);


const textureW = Math.max(1, sprite.texture?.width ?? 800);


const textureH = Math.max(1, sprite.texture?.height ?? 600);


const aspect = textureW / textureH;


sprite.height = size * Number(params.vfxScale ?? 1.45);


sprite.width = sprite.height * aspect;


sprite.zIndex = Number(params.vfxZ ?? 6300);


sprite.alpha = 1;


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


await waitMs(Number(params.vfxMs ?? 700));


try {


canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);


sprite.destroy();


} catch (_) {}


}


async function blinkToken(token) {


if (!token) return;


const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;


if (!baseObj) return;


const feedbackDelay = Number(params.damageFeedbackDelayMs ?? 0);


if (feedbackDelay > 0) {


await waitMs(feedbackDelay);


}


const originalAlpha = baseObj.alpha ?? 1;


const times = Number(params.blinkTimes ?? 3);


const low = Number(params.blinkLowAlpha ?? 0.25);


const step = Number(params.blinkStepMs ?? 55);


try {


for (let i = 0; i < times; i++) {


baseObj.alpha = low;


await waitMs(step);


baseObj.alpha = originalAlpha;


await waitMs(step);


}


} finally {


baseObj.alpha = originalAlpha;


}


}


function getFrontPoint(caster, target) {


const casterX = caster.center.x;


const targetX = target.center.x;


const offset = Number(params.frontOffsetPx ?? 115);


// Stand on the side of the target closest to the caster.


const side = casterX >= targetX ? 1 : -1;


return {


x: target.center.x + (side * offset),


y: target.center.y


};


}


const casterBaseObj = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;


const originalCasterVisible = casterToken.visible;


const originalCasterMeshVisible = casterBaseObj?.visible ?? true;


let casterSprite = null;


try {


const home = {


x: casterToken.center.x,


y: casterToken.center.y


};


const primaryTarget = targetTokens?.[0] ?? null;


const front = primaryTarget ? getFrontPoint(casterToken, primaryTarget) : home;


casterSprite = await makeTokenClone(casterToken, Number(params.casterZ ?? 6200));


if (casterBaseObj) casterBaseObj.visible = false;


casterToken.visible = false;


await animateXY(


casterSprite,


home,


front,


Number(params.moveInMs ?? 320)


);


const targets = Array.isArray(targetTokens) ? targetTokens.filter(Boolean) : [];


await Promise.all([


...targets.map(t => playSlashVfx(t)),


...targets.map(t => blinkToken(t))


]);


await animateXY(


casterSprite,


{ x: casterSprite.x, y: casterSprite.y },


home,


Number(params.returnMs ?? 280)


);


} finally {


if (casterSprite) {


try {


canvas.stage.removeChild(casterSprite);


casterSprite.destroy();


} catch (_) {}


}


if (casterBaseObj) casterBaseObj.visible = originalCasterMeshVisible;


casterToken.visible = originalCasterVisible;


}


`;


game.ONI.pseudo.play({


scriptId: "oni.greatAxe.thievery.melee",


scriptSource,


casterTokenUuid: casterToken.document.uuid,


targetTokenUuids: targetTokens.map(t => t.document?.uuid).filter(Boolean),


params: {


vfxFile: VFX_FILE,


moveInMs: MOVE_IN_MS,


vfxMs: VFX_MS,


returnMs: RETURN_MS,


frontOffsetPx: FRONT_OFFSET_PX,


casterZ: CASTER_Z,


vfxZ: VFX_Z,


vfxScale: VFX_SCALE,


blinkTimes: BLINK_TIMES,


blinkLowAlpha: BLINK_LOW_ALPHA,


blinkStepMs: BLINK_STEP_MS,


damageFeedbackDelayMs: DAMAGE_FEEDBACK_DELAY_MS


},


meta: {


source: "Great Axe / Thievery",


kind: "generic_melee_attack"


}


});


const totalWait =


MOVE_IN_MS +


VFX_MS +


RETURN_MS +


END_BUFFER_MS;


await wait(totalWait);


return true;


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);


return false;


} finally {


ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {


...eventBase,


timestamp: Date.now()


}, { local: true, world: false });


}


})();

const TAG = "[CL-RES][IP-DRAIN-2]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const userActor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (!userActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing user actor.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const escapeHTML = foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ?? ((v) => String(v ?? ""));

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

const getUserTokenName = () => {

if (typeof _token !== "undefined" && _token?.name) return _token.name;

return userActor?.name ?? "User";

};

const getTargetDisplayName = (targetDoc, targetActor) => {

return targetDoc?.name ?? targetActor?.name ?? "Target";

};

async function postStealFeedbackHtml(innerHtml) {

const FLAG_SCOPE = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "oniHideChatHeader";

let hookId = null;

hookId = Hooks.on("renderChatMessage", (message, html) => {

if (!message?.getFlag?.(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY)) return;

html.find(".message-header").remove();

html.find(".message-sender").remove();

html.find(".message-metadata").remove();

html.find(".message-avatar").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-container").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-message-portrait").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-image").remove();

html.find("img.chat-portrait").remove();

Hooks.off("renderChatMessage", hookId);

});

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

speaker: { alias: "" },

content: `

${innerHtml}

`,

flags: {

[FLAG_SCOPE]: {

[FLAG_KEY]: true

}

}

});

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const userTokenName = getUserTokenName();

const targetName = getTargetDisplayName(targetDoc, targetActor);

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

console.log(TAG, "HIT CHECK", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit,

targetDef,

hit

});

if (!hit) {

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userMaxIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.max_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const requestedSteal = 2;

// The steal amount depends only on the target's current IP.

// Even if the user is already at max IP, the target still loses IP.

const actualSteal = Math.min(requestedSteal, targetIpBefore);

if (actualSteal <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No IP stolen", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

targetIpBefore,

userIpBefore,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpAfter = Math.max(0, targetIpBefore - actualSteal);

// User gain is clamped by max IP, but does not affect the steal amount.

const actualGain = Math.min(actualSteal, Math.max(0, userMaxIp - userIpBefore));

const userIpAfter = Math.min(userMaxIp, userIpBefore + actualGain);

await targetActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(targetIpAfter)

});

await userActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(userIpAfter)

});

console.log(TAG, "IP TRANSFER APPLIED", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

actualSteal,

actualGain,

targetIpBefore,

targetIpAfter,

userIpBefore,

userIpAfter,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(

`${escapeHTML(userTokenName)} steals ${escapeHTML(actualSteal)} IP from ${escapeHTML(targetName)}!`

);

}

props.passive_logic_action:
const TAG = "[PASSIVE-ACTION][Bandit Trigger]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return context.skipPassive("Bandit Trigger: missing payload.", { notify: false });

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

// --------------------------------------------------

// 1. Confirm this passive was fired by

// "Whenever a creature performs an action"

// --------------------------------------------------

const phase =

p?.meta?.reaction_phase_payload ??

p?.reaction_phase_payload ??

{};

const triggerKey =

p?.meta?.passiveTriggerKey ??

p?.reaction_trigger_key ??

phase?.trigger ??

"";

if (triggerKey && triggerKey !== "creature_performs_action") {

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 2. Check whether the triggering action is an Attack

// --------------------------------------------------

const norm = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const actionContext = phase?.actionContext ?? {};

const actionTypeCandidates = [

phase?.sourceType,

phase?.listType,

phase?.skillTypeRaw,

phase?.skill_type,

actionContext?.meta?.sourceType,

actionContext?.meta?.listType,

actionContext?.meta?.skillTypeRaw,

actionContext?.core?.skillTypeRaw,

actionContext?.dataCore?.skillTypeRaw,

actionContext?.dataCore?.listType,

p?.meta?.sourceType,

p?.meta?.listType,

p?.meta?.skillTypeRaw,

p?.core?.skillTypeRaw,

p?.dataCore?.skillTypeRaw,

p?.dataCore?.listType

].map(norm).filter(Boolean);

const isAttack = actionTypeCandidates.includes("attack");

if (!isAttack) {

context.log(`${TAG} skipped: triggering action is not Attack.`, {

actionTypeCandidates

});

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 3. Resolve target

// Priority:

// - triggering action targets from reaction payload

// - current passive payload targets

// - helper fallback

// --------------------------------------------------

const targetUuids = [

...(Array.isArray(phase?.targets) ? phase.targets : []),

...(Array.isArray(actionContext?.originalTargetUUIDs) ? actionContext.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(actionContext?.targets) ? actionContext.targets : []),

...(Array.isArray(p?.originalTargetUUIDs) ? p.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(p?.targets) ? p.targets : [])

].filter(Boolean).map(String);

const uniqueTargetUuids = [...new Set(targetUuids)];

let targetActor = null;

let targetDoc = null;

if (uniqueTargetUuids.length) {

targetDoc = await fromUuid(uniqueTargetUuids[0]).catch(() => null);

targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

}

if (!targetActor && context.helpers?.getFirstTargetActor) {

targetActor = await context.helpers.getFirstTargetActor();

}

if (!targetActor) {

context.warn(`${TAG} skipped: no target actor found.`, {

phaseTargets: phase?.targets,

payloadTargets: p?.targets

});

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 4. Read target IP and calculate bonus

// Formula: (target IP * 10) / 5

// Simplifies to target IP * 2

// --------------------------------------------------

const props = targetActor.system?.props ?? {};

const targetIP = Math.max(0, Number(props.current_ip ?? props.ip ?? 0) || 0);

const bonusDamage = Math.floor((targetIP * 10) / 5);

if (bonusDamage <= 0) {

context.log(`${TAG} skipped: target has no IP.`, {

target: targetActor.name,

targetIP

});

return context.skipPassive("", { notify: false });

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// 5. Add bonus damage to the action damage

// --------------------------------------------------

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + bonusDamage;

p.meta.banditTrigger = {

applied: true,

targetName: targetActor.name,

targetIP,

formula: `(${targetIP} * 10) / 5`,

bonusDamage,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

};

context.log(`${TAG} applied.`, p.meta.banditTrigger);

const MOVE_IN_MS = 320;


const HIT_DELAY_MS = MOVE_IN_MS + 40;


const VFX_MS = 700;


const RETURN_MS = 280;


const END_BUFFER_MS = 140;


// Delay before the target blink feedback starts.


// Good range: 80–180ms.

const DAMAGE_FEEDBACK_DELAY_MS = 130;

const FRONT_OFFSET_PX = 115; // how far in front of target the caster stops


const CASTER_Z = 6200;

const { local = true, world = false } = options;


if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);


if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });


};


}


async function resolveTokenFromUuid(uuid) {


if (!uuid || typeof uuid !== "string") return null;


try {


const doc = await fromUuid(uuid);


if (doc?.documentName === "Token") {


return doc.object ?? null;


}


if (doc?.documentName === "Actor") {


return doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;


}


if (doc?.actor?.getActiveTokens) {


return doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;


}


return doc?.object ?? null;


} catch (err) {


console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve UUID:", uuid, err);


return null;

const candidates = [


p?.sourceTokenUuid,


p?.casterTokenUuid,


p?.tokenUuid,


p?.tokenUUID,


p?.meta?.sourceTokenUuid,


p?.meta?.casterTokenUuid,


p?.meta?.attackerTokenUuid,


p?.meta?.attackerUuid,


p?.attackerUuid,


p?.attackerActorUuid


].filter(Boolean);


for (const uuid of candidates) {


const token = await resolveTokenFromUuid(uuid);


if (token) return token;


}


return null;

const out = [];


const pushToken = async (value) => {


if (!value) return;


if (value?.document?.documentName === "Token") {


out.push(value);


return;


}

if (value.object) out.push(value.object);


return;


}

const token = await resolveTokenFromUuid(value);


if (token) out.push(token);

for (const t of fromArg) await pushToken(t);

p?.targetTokenUuids,


p?.targetTokenUUIDs,


p?.originalTargetUUIDs,


p?.targets,


p?.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs,


p?.meta?.targets


];


for (const list of uuidLists) {


if (!Array.isArray(list)) continue;


for (const uuid of list) await pushToken(uuid);

const seen = new Set();


return out.filter(t => {

if (!id || seen.has(id)) return false;


seen.add(id);


return true;


});


}

const casterToken = await resolveCasterToken(p);


const targetTokens = await resolveTargetTokens(p, targets ?? globalThis.__TARGETS ?? []);

return false;

if (!targetTokens.length) {


console.warn(TAG, "No target tokens resolved from payload. Animation cancelled.");


return false;

type: "greatAxeThieveryMelee",


sourceTokenId: casterToken.id,


sourceTokenUuid: casterToken.document?.uuid ?? null,


targetTokenIds: targetTokens.map(t => t.id),

const waitMs = wait;


function easeInOutCubic(t) {


return t < 0.5


? 4 * t * t * t


: 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;


}

return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / Math.max(1, durMs);


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function makeTokenClone(token, zIndex) {


const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;


const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.y = token.center.y;


if (baseObj) {


sprite.width = baseObj.width;


sprite.height = baseObj.height;

sprite.width = token.w;


sprite.height = token.h;


}


sprite.zIndex = zIndex;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();

}

let texture = null;


try {


texture = await loadTexture(file);


} catch (_) {

}


const video =


texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source ??


texture?.source?.resource?.source ??


null;

try {


video.loop = false;


video.muted = true;


video.currentTime = 0;


await video.play();


} catch (_) {}


}


return new PIXI.Sprite(texture);


}

if (!targetToken) return;


const sprite = await makeVideoSprite(params.vfxFile);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = targetToken.center.x;


sprite.y = targetToken.center.y;


const size = Math.max(targetToken.w ?? 100, targetToken.h ?? 100);


const textureW = Math.max(1, sprite.texture?.width ?? 800);


const textureH = Math.max(1, sprite.texture?.height ?? 600);


const aspect = textureW / textureH;


sprite.height = size * Number(params.vfxScale ?? 1.45);


sprite.width = sprite.height * aspect;


sprite.zIndex = Number(params.vfxZ ?? 6300);


sprite.alpha = 1;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


await waitMs(Number(params.vfxMs ?? 700));


try {


canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);


sprite.destroy();


} catch (_) {}


}


async function blinkToken(token) {


if (!token) return;


const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;


if (!baseObj) return;


const feedbackDelay = Number(params.damageFeedbackDelayMs ?? 0);


if (feedbackDelay > 0) {


await waitMs(feedbackDelay);


}


const originalAlpha = baseObj.alpha ?? 1;


const times = Number(params.blinkTimes ?? 3);


const low = Number(params.blinkLowAlpha ?? 0.25);


const step = Number(params.blinkStepMs ?? 55);


try {


for (let i = 0; i < times; i++) {


baseObj.alpha = low;


await waitMs(step);


baseObj.alpha = originalAlpha;


await waitMs(step);


}


} finally {


baseObj.alpha = originalAlpha;


}


}

const casterX = caster.center.x;


const targetX = target.center.x;


const offset = Number(params.frontOffsetPx ?? 115);

casterSprite,


home,


front,


Number(params.moveInMs ?? 320)

...targets.map(t => playSlashVfx(t)),

await animateXY(


casterSprite,


{ x: casterSprite.x, y: casterSprite.y },


home,


Number(params.returnMs ?? 280)


);


} finally {


if (casterSprite) {


try {


canvas.stage.removeChild(casterSprite);


casterSprite.destroy();


} catch (_) {}


}


if (casterBaseObj) casterBaseObj.visible = originalCasterMeshVisible;


casterToken.visible = originalCasterVisible;


}

scriptId: "oni.greatAxe.thievery.melee",


scriptSource,


casterTokenUuid: casterToken.document.uuid,


targetTokenUuids: targetTokens.map(t => t.document?.uuid).filter(Boolean),


params: {


vfxFile: VFX_FILE,


moveInMs: MOVE_IN_MS,


vfxMs: VFX_MS,


returnMs: RETURN_MS,


frontOffsetPx: FRONT_OFFSET_PX,


casterZ: CASTER_Z,


vfxZ: VFX_Z,


vfxScale: VFX_SCALE,


blinkTimes: BLINK_TIMES,


blinkLowAlpha: BLINK_LOW_ALPHA,


blinkStepMs: BLINK_STEP_MS,


damageFeedbackDelayMs: DAMAGE_FEEDBACK_DELAY_MS


},


meta: {

const totalWait =


MOVE_IN_MS +


VFX_MS +


RETURN_MS +
